title: Reclaim structural exclusion
description: Paths Reclaim structurally refuses to touch — credentials, settings and user data that live beside targeted caches. Entries are a ban list, not a scan list: a path here need not exist on disk. Each entry bans three things at once: the path itself, anything inside it, and any target that claims one of its ancestors. One file per entry under Catalogue/exclusions/<id>.json. Full guide: docs/CATALOGUE.md.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema so editors validate and autocomplete the manifest. Always '../schema/exclusion.schema.json'.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier. Must equal the file name without '.json'.

group.description: The heading this entry is listed under in Settings → 'Excluded from scans'.

paths.description: Literal tilde-form or absolute paths (no globs), no trailing slash — the same shape as target paths, but always literal. Several sibling paths sharing one reason may live in one entry.

reason.description: Short noun phrase shown in Settings, e.g. 'auth token', 'cluster credentials'. Reuse the phrasing of an existing exclusion when one fits — the standard list is in docs/CATALOGUE.md.

localizedText.description: Per-locale text. Every supported locale is required. Machine translation is acceptable for 'nb' — flag it in your PR so a native speaker reviews it.
